subject: Keep game assets in one team workspace
body:

subject: Add 3D generation to your asset workflow
body:
Hi,

Still handling 3D generation requests outside the tools your team uses?

Use Tripo API to submit a generation task, check its status, and retrieve the model after it succeeds. Connect that sequence to the game tools or asset workflow you build.

Start with the Quick Start, then review the output against your project's requirements before using it in production.
